prose_by: the author, written before reading Beezer
expected_by: proposed by Claude with the Beezer statement and a reason, accepted by the author
embedded: prose_en only; the name before the colon is a label and is never embedded

items.name: ĉ₁
items.prose_es: punto de anclaje, centroide que fija el origen, normalizado para obtener su dirección.
items.prose_en: anchor point, centroid that fixes the origin, normalized to obtain its direction.

items.name: P⊥
items.prose_es: quita a cualquier vector su parte a lo largo del ancla, devuelve el vector menos su proyección sobre c1.
items.prose_en: removes from any vector its part along the anchor, returns the vector minus its projection on the anchor.

items.name: v_dipole
items.prose_es: dirección de la recta que une los 2 centroides proyectados; porta el espacio comprendido entre ambos y λ dice dónde cae el estímulo sobre ella.
items.prose_en: direction of the line that joins the 2 projected centroids; it carries the space between them.

items.name: r
items.prose_es: la proyección del vector entrante sobre el resto, desde el anclaje.
items.prose_en: the projection of the incoming vector on the rest, from the anchor.

items.name: λ
items.prose_es: mide cuánto del eje conocido [−1, 1] recorre el vector entrante. Su energía asociada es E_λ.
items.prose_en: measures how much of the known axis, as a number between minus one and one, the incoming vector travels. It has an associated energy.

items.name: d_esc
items.prose_es: mide la distancia recorrida fuera del eje conocido; su energía asociada es E_esc = d_esc².
items.prose_en: measures the distance traveled outside the known axis; its associated energy is the square of that distance.

items.name: y
items.prose_es: cuánto del vector entrante se proyecta sobre la dirección del ancla.
items.prose_en: how much of the incoming vector is projected over the direction of the anchor.

items.name: Canonical fallback
items.prose_en: axis perpendicular to the anchor when the union of 2 poles against the anchor occurs.

items.name: Exact Pythagoras
items.prose_en: total distribution of energy between the axis and the outside of it.

items.name: Least squares
items.prose_en: the smallest sample of energy that is left out when projecting on the axis; the coefficient left by the minimum remainder.

items.name: Orthogonal complement
items.prose_en: the subspace of what is perpendicular to the anchor.

items.name: Null
items.prose_en: the subspace of what gives zero against the anchor.

items.name: Canonical vectors
items.prose_en: a one in one position and zeros in the rest.

items.name: Orthogonality
items.prose_en: 2 vectors are orthogonal if they are seen the same from the front as from behind: the distance to the other is the same as to its opposite.

items.name: Projection coefficient
items.prose_en: the distribution of the shadow of the incoming vector over the total size of the axis.

items.name: Range-1
items.prose_en: the entire operator works on the direction of the anchor.

items.name: Batch form
items.prose_en: apply the operation to the set of incoming vectors at the same time.

items.name: Linearity
items.prose_en: it doesn't matter to subtract the poles and project or to project each one and subtract.

items.name: RMS dimension
items.prose_en: the guarantee that there is always a small coordinate from which to build the unit vector.

items.name: Direct sum
items.prose_en: the shadow of the incoming vector is divided into 2 perpendicular zones, along the axis or outside it, which together make up the total.

items.name: 384d
items.prose_es: El vector se reparte en 384 dimensiones, cada una de ellas es una coordenada en la cual el vector se proyecta.
items.prose_en: The vector is divided into 384 dimensions, each of which is a coordinate on which the vector is projected.

items.name: 8 axes
items.prose_es: Son 8 dimensiones iniciales sobre las que se proyectan los vectores de 384d; son 8 direcciones iniciales de arranque, no describen el vector entero al tratarse de artificiales.
items.prose_en: These are 8 initial dimensions on which the vectors of 384 dimensions are projected; they are 8 initial starting directions, they do not describe the entire vector as they are artificial.

items.name: Coordinates 8 axes
items.prose_es: Cuánto se dispersa el vector en cada eje.
items.prose_en: How much the vector is scattered on each axis.

items.name: Cosine
items.prose_es: Mide lo parecidas que son 2 notas según el ángulo entre sus vectores, a menor ángulo, mayor similitud.
items.prose_en: Measure how similar 2 notes are according to the angle between their vectors, the lower the angle, the greater the similarity.

items.name: Transpose
items.prose_es: Tras obtener la firma espectral en 8d, giramos la matriz para conseguir un vector aproximado en 384d.
items.prose_en: After obtaining the spectral signature in 8 dimensions, we rotate the matrix to obtain an approximate vector in 384 dimensions.

items.name: SVD
items.prose_es: Dentro de un conjunto de vectores, eliminar lo común y calcular la dirección del conjunto.
items.prose_en: Within a set of vectors, eliminate the common and calculate the direction of the set.

items.name: Medium
items.prose_es: Mezclar vectores con diferentes pesos y calcular un vector nuevo que es su promedio.
items.prose_en: Mix vectors with different weights and calculate a new vector that is your average.

items.name: Euclidean Distance
items.prose_en: The Straight-Line Distance Between 2 Vectors
